name: Priya M.
text: Bought this for my consulting practice and had it live in an afternoon. The contact form actually worked out of the box, which is more than I can say for the last two templates I paid for.

name: Daniel K.
text: Used this for my training studio's site. Clients keep commenting on how the class schedule table looks — didn't expect that from a template.

name: Sarah T.
text: Clean code, easy to re-skin. Took me about 2 hours to swap in my own business details.

name: Marcus V.
text: Customized this for a client's law firm — they were genuinely impressed. Worth every rupee for the multi-page structure alone.
